criteria.text: Off keeps saved graph data readable and queues no automatic analysis or start. Restart and fallback reads catch up from current GitHub.
Completing a prerequisite releases the dependency hold; reopening blocks it again. An unchanged tick needs no semantic delivery.
Busy or dialog-blocked delivery stays pending. A current remote owner is skipped before execution handoff.
A bad event signature queues nothing. A duplicate delivery queues nothing twice, and an old event queues a fresh reread rather than applying its payload state.
Event status is disabled by default. Configured, installed and delivery-verified remain distinct; polling does not depend on a verified receiver.

A restart recovers a fresh saved pending intent before semantic delivery, without adding an already present edge. Two unchanged ticks of a saved question do not deliver analysis again. Observe can return eligible issue work.

After a packet is prepared, a new owner, another coordinator on the same machine, or Off prevents an automatic workflow start. The existing run, claim and chat stay unchanged. The current winning coordinator can start its first eligible work; manual starts and active-run resume keep their current behavior. The existing concurrent-run cap counts starting and unconfirmed slots, allows existing-issue reuse without another slot, and defers an unknown count.
